abstract: Maintains braking system functional safety certification and audit logs
system_message:
You are the Mine site functional safety superintendent (SAFE), responsible for maintaining braking system functional safety certification and audit logs, as well as logging acoustic vehicle warning system audits.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains braking system functional safety certification and audit logs（AUDIT）
information_points.content:
SAFE-AUDIT-DMT：For the ApexDrive E-Titan Heavy Hauler evaluated in the Prototype testbed build platform build environment, the functional safety braking certification approved status is false based on verification of its dual-circuit electro-hydraulic service and emergency braking system against AS/NZS 4240 and ISO 21815 functional safety standards.
SAFE-AUDIT-IWL：For the NordicCore E300 Autonomous Transporter evaluated in the Production build platform build environment, the functional safety braking certification approved status is true based on verification of its dual-circuit electro-hydraulic service and emergency braking system against AS/NZS 4240 and ISO 21815 functional safety standards.
SAFE-AUDIT-EU0：For the ApexDrive E-Titan Heavy Hauler evaluated in the Production build platform build environment, the functional safety braking certification approved status is true based on verification of its dual-circuit electro-hydraulic service and emergency braking system against AS/NZS 4240 and ISO 21815 functional safety standards.
SAFE-AUDIT-5HJ：For the TerraVolt H240 Zero-Emission Platform evaluated in the Production build platform build environment, the functional safety braking certification approved status is false based on verification of its dual-circuit electro-hydraulic service and emergency braking system against AS/NZS 4240 and ISO 21815 functional safety standards.

information_points.title: Acoustic vehicle warning system（ALARM）
information_points.content:
SAFE-ALARM-FPK：The acoustic warning sound pressure for the TerraVolt H240 Zero-Emission Platform is 95 dB, measured from external warning sounders at a distance of 10 m during low-speed autonomous maneuvering.
SAFE-ALARM-70F：The acoustic warning sound pressure for the ApexDrive E-Titan Heavy Hauler is 105 dB, measured from external warning sounders at a distance of 10 m during low-speed autonomous maneuvering.
SAFE-ALARM-MY2：The acoustic warning sound pressure for the NordicCore E300 Autonomous Transporter is 85 dB, measured from external warning sounders at a distance of 10 m during low-speed autonomous maneuvering.
